palette: Totoy 36, hard alpha; no reserved gold x,y or red z,A
scale: 1x game pixels (nearest-neighbour; preview sheets are scaled copies)
status: Reference art for the human's approval; not imported into art/src, not wired into the game
aspect: Phantom Cut (suggested display name: PHANTOM CUT; subtitle idea: 'THE BLADE REMEMBERS')
request: v2: a 5 s buff; EVERY basic attack during it spawns a delayed phantom copy of the same swing a moment later, for all three weapons. Delay, damage and cost are owner/core decisions.

groups.fx_phantom_glow_<hero frame>_<1..6>: Sustained buff glow, drawn ON TOP of the hero frame named <hero frame> (for example fx_phantom_glow_hero2_attack2_right_3_4 over hero2_attack2_right_3), placed by its own anchor at the hero's feet and mirrored with him. Cropped to the glow (anchor = the hero frame's feet point in the crop). Six shimmer phases, loop at about 80 ms over the whole 5 s, independent of the hero frame: the weapon's metal brightened with a cream glint running along it, a lilac rim and halo, three motes. Made for every frame of idle 1-4, walk 1-6, dash 1-4, parry 1-6, hurt 1-4 and attack<s> 1-6 of hero2 (katana, 3 swings), totoy_dagger (4 swings) and totoy_scythe (3 swings).
groups.fx_phantom_start_<1..5>: 48x48, anchor (24,44) = Totoy's feet. Buff start: ghost star at the chest, a lilac ring opens at the feet, ghost streaks rise, motes. Draw over the hero; start the glow with frame 1.
groups.fx_phantom_end_<1..4>: 48x48, anchor (24,44). Buff end: the glow tears off in lilac shreds that drift up, a small ring closes at the feet. The glow stops at frame 1.
groups.fx_phantom_ghost_<weapon>_<swing>_<1..4>: The phantom: <set>_attack<swing>_right_<3,4,4,5> recoloured (lilac outline, checkerboard body, bright metal), weapon = katana (hero2) / dagger (totoy_dagger) / scythe (totoy_scythe). Same size/anchor as its source frame. 1 forming, 2 full (with speed streaks), 3 thinning, 4 fragments. Draw at Totoy's feet + ghost_offset_px along his facing, mirrored with him.
groups.fx_phantom_arc_<weapon>_<swing>_<1..4>: The echo slash over the phantom, anchor = the phantom's feet. katana 96x64 (40,56): wide ghost crescents (v1 arcs). dagger 64x48 (16,44): short fast ghost slashes (1 twin thrust cuts, 2 rising backhand, 3 crossed X, 4 big downward finisher). scythe 96x64 (40,56): fx_scythe_arc_<swing>_<phase> recoloured, so the echo has the scythe's own crescent. Phases lead/peak/follow/fragments, about 35/55/55/70 ms.
groups.fx_phantom_spark_<1..5>: 32x32, anchor (16,16) = where an echo hits. Pinch, star + ring, ring opens, broken ring + sparks, motes. Start it on arc phase 2.
groups.fx_phantom_marker_<1..4>: 16x16, anchor (8,15) = bottom centre; place 3 px above Totoy's head while the buff runs (the 'echo pending' cue; loop about 120 ms). Small ghost katana, bobbing, glint running up.

suggested_timeline: cast: fx_phantom_start 1-5 + glow + marker on. For 5 s: every swing's real hit, then about 0.25 s later ghost 1-4 + arc 1-4 of that weapon and swing (arc 2 = the phantom hit) and spark 1-5 on the target; echoes may overlap the next swing. At the end: glow and marker off, fx_phantom_end 1-4.
